paper_title: First results of the CAST-RADES haloscope search for axions at 34.67 μeV
notes: Exclusion limit of g_aγγ ≥ 2.4×10^-13 GeV^-1 set over mass range 34.6738 μeV < m_a < 34.6771 μeV at 95% credibility level. Single-cavity measurement at fixed resonant frequency 8.384 GHz, with narrow bandwidth. Limit is approximately flat across the narrow mass range probed, represented as two points at the edges. First results from CAST-RADES collaboration, improving on previous CAST solar axion searches. No dark matter density assumption as this is a cavity haloscope (not a direct dark matter search) measuring axion-to-photon conversion in a magnetic field.
